title: IO Data Source
text: Simulate and playback recorded task events, 1 input, 1 output, {Input} sets Source of input data From; {Sample time} sets the time interval of sampling and {Object name} sets the name. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input
params.values: Source of input data From dialog (default) | From input port | From timeseries object

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval of sampling -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Object name
params.values: Name of timeseries object [] (default) | timeseries object
